champion_token.name: Champion's Token
champion_token.lore: Stamped with a fist. The Discipline Offering in the Tournament Court wants it.

grandmaster_key.name: Grandmaster Key
grandmaster_key.lore: Opens the dojo door to the Grandmaster Circle.

waves.say: The ring is yours. Three students step in to test you.

onDone.text: The bout is yours. A Champion's Token lies on the mat.
The dojo gate rolls aside and a stair climbs the mountain beyond.
The board nods. A door in the north wall slides back on a retired master's room.

mechanics.doneText: The belts are in rank order.
mechanics.failText: Not that order. Read the strip above the board: yellow, white, black.

onOpen.text: The token is placed. The vault gate in the south wall rolls open.

mechanics.hint: A stone dish at the champion's feet, shaped to hold a token.
mechanics.verb: lays the Champion's Token in the dish and the vault gate rolls open.

onOpen.text: The dojo door to the Grandmaster Circle slides open.

mechanics.hint: A dojo door, one panel inscribed with a closed fist and a keyhole.
mechanics.verb: turns the Grandmaster Key and the dojo door slides open.

encounters.say: Students bow. Then they do not stop bowing. The pit beyond is the real test.
The court is empty and the stands are not. Three pads wait in the north; a dish at the champion's feet.

bosses.name: The Grandmaster
bosses.intro: The Grandmaster bows, once. Break the three gold seals on the pillars to take away its stance.
bosses.deathText: The Grandmaster bows again, lower, and does not rise.

shield.breakText: The seals break! The Grandmaster is open!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Grandmaster calls its servants.

effects.text: The Grandmaster calls the senior class.
The floor rings like a drum.

completion.intro: The Grandmaster's Dojo. Cross the balance route, climb the ascetic steps, and take a champion's token.
completion.message: The dojo is silent. It closes shortly.
